description: Client-side script for the 'Issue' doctype in ERPNext, handling form load, button actions, and timeline interactions.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: Dialog class used for resetting Service Level Agreement and other interactions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form fields, sets queries, and adds buttons based on issue status.

methods.name: reset_service_level_agreement
methods.description: Opens a dialog to reset the SLA with a reason, then calls the server to perform the reset.

methods.name: timeline_refresh
methods.description: Adds a 'Split Issue' button to the timeline and handles its click event to split issues.
